Claim 12 (Currently amended): A welding wire and container assembly, comprising: a housing consisting essentially of a recyclable material, the housing comprising: a cylindrical wall having a first end and a second end, wherein the cylindrical wall comprises a plurality of triangular portions folded radially inward at the second end; a support structure coupled to the plurality of triangular portions to provide a layered end assembly, wherein the support structure further comprises a base that supports a coil of welding wire disposed in the housing.
